definitions.gloss: Honshu; the main island of Japan
definitions.explanation: The largest and most populous of Japan's four main islands, home to major cities including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Nagoya. Located between Hokkaido to the north and Shikoku and Kyushu to the south.

examples.japanese: {本州|ほんしゅう}は{日本|にほん}で{一番|いちばん}{大|おお}きい{島|しま}だ。
examples.english: Honshu is the largest island in Japan.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}も{大阪|おおさか}も{本州|ほんしゅう}にある。
examples.english: Both Tokyo and Osaka are on Honshu.

examples.japanese: {本州|ほんしゅう}と{北海道|ほっかいどう}は{青函|せいかん}トンネルでつながっている。
examples.english: Honshu and Hokkaido are connected by the Seikan Tunnel.

notes: Literally 'main province.' Japan's four main islands are: {北海道|ほっかいどう} (Hokkaido), {本州|ほんしゅう} (Honshu), {四国|しこく} (Shikoku), and {九州|きゅうしゅう} (Kyushu). Honshu is the seventh-largest island in the world and contains roughly 80% of Japan's population. The regions of {東北|とうほく}, {関東|かんとう}, {中部|ちゅうぶ}, {近畿|きんき}, and {中国|ちゅうごく} are all on Honshu.
